name: Airtable
one_liner: Base/table/record database platform with a REST Web API at api.airtable.com/v0.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens (self-created at airtable.com/create/tokens) as Bearer; OAuth integrations registered by any developer with redirect URL and scopes (token creation per OAuth reference). Legacy API keys deprecated.
access_notes: Web API is available on all plan types; Free is capped at 1000 calls per workspace per month, Team 100,000, Business/Enterprise unlimited. 5 requests/sec per base on all tiers, no increases. No app review step found in the OAuth registration guide.
sandbox_or_test_env: Free plan workspace usable for testing (1000 calls/month cap)

buildability.rationale: Self-serve PAT and OAuth registration, documented REST, webhooks API and rate limits. Free tier call cap (1000/month) and 5 rps per base are practical limits, not gates.

disputes.why: Airtable's own help center documents an Airtable MCP server (all plans); felixrieseberg repo is a third-party community project.
